About the ESA

UBC’s English Students’ Association is a club for English literature and language honours, major, and minor students, as well as any other UBC students with an interest in literature.

The club provides academic and social events to facilitate connections between students and faculty, support students with career and academic resources, and provide community and connection for students.

Additionally, the club provides platforms for students to share academic and creative work, including the ESA blog, the annual Colloquium and UBC’s English undergraduate journal, The Garden Statuary.
